title: DP15106 Layoffs and Productivity at a Bangladeshi Sweater Factory
title_zh: 孟加拉国毛衣工厂的裁员与生产率
title_primary: 孟加拉国毛衣工厂的裁员与生产率
title_secondary: DP15106 Layoffs and Productivity at a Bangladeshi Sweater Factory
authors: Robert Akerlof, Anik Ashraf, Rocco Macchiavello, Atonu Rabbani
official: 官方在线 2020-07-29 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Conflicts between management and workers are common and can have significant impacts on productivity. We study how workers in a large Bangladeshi sweater factory responded to management’s decision to lay off about a quarter of the workers following a period of labor unrest. Our main finding is that the mass layoff resulted in a large and persistent reduction in the productivity of surviving workers. Moreover, it is specifically the firing of peers with whom workers had social connections – \textit{friends} – that matters. We also provide suggestive evidence of deliberate shading of performance by workers in order to punish the factory’s management, and a corresponding deliberate attempt by the factory to win the angry workers back by selectively giving them tasks that are more rewarding. By combining ethnographic and survey data on the socialization process with the factory’s internal records, the paper provides a rare glimpse into the aftermath of an episode of labor unrest. A portrait of the firm emerges as a web of interconnected relational agreements supported by social connections.
abstract_zh: 管理层与工人之间的冲突屡见不鲜，且可能对生产力产生重大影响。我们研究了孟加拉国一家大型毛衣工厂在经历一段劳工动荡后，管理层决定裁减约四分之一的工人，工人们对此如何反应。我们的主要发现是，大规模裁员导致幸存工人的生产力出现大幅且持续的下降。此外，关键在于被解雇的是那些与工人有社会联系的同伴——即“朋友”。我们还提供了暗示性证据，表明工人故意降低工作表现以惩罚工厂管理层，而工厂则相应地试图通过有选择地分配更有回报的任务来挽回愤怒的工人。通过将关于社会化过程的人种学与调查数据同工厂内部记录相结合，本文为劳工动荡事件后的情形提供了罕见的洞察。企业形象由此浮现为一个由社会联系支撑的相互关联的关系协议网络。

title: Endogenous networks with constrained public goods
title_zh: 约束公共品的内生网络
title_primary: 约束公共品的内生网络
title_secondary: Endogenous networks with constrained public goods
abstract: This paper incorporates individual effort constraints into a network formation framework with local public goods. Strict Nash equilibria are characterised, featuring complete multipartite networks as a novel class of stratified structures, where agents are organised into distinct layers based on heterogeneous effort levels, with full inter-layer connectivity and no intra-layer links. We further show that such constraints weaken the law of the few by limiting extreme concentration of effort provision. As a result, equilibrium networks exhibit broader participation in production and layered patterns of effort provision. abstract_zh: 本文将个体努力约束纳入具有地方公共物品的网络形成框架中。严格纳什均衡被刻画，其特征是完全多部网络作为一种新型的分层结构，其中代理人根据异质性努力水平被组织成不同层级，层级间完全连接而层级内无连接。我们进一步表明，此类约束通过限制努力供给的极端集中，削弱了少数定律。因此，均衡网络在生产参与上表现出更广泛的分布，并呈现努力供给的分层模式。图形摘要 下载：下载高分辨率图像（255KB） 下载：下载全尺寸图像

title: Mapping Technological Trajectories: Evidence from Two Centuries of Patent Data
title_zh: 技术轨迹的映射：来自两个世纪专利数据的证据
title_primary: 技术轨迹的映射：来自两个世纪专利数据的证据
title_secondary: Mapping Technological Trajectories: Evidence from Two Centuries of Patent Data
authors: Bergeaud, Antonin, Nur Gozen, Ruveyda, van Reenen, John, van Reenen, John Michael
official: 官方在线 2026-07-20 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We introduce a methodology to measure cross-country trends in innovation capability- "technological trajectoriesâ€ and implement this on a new rich dataset covering patents between 1836 and 2016 across multiple countries. Intuitively, trajectories are revealed by a country's sustained increases in patenting across multiple patent offices. We first describe the data patterns, showing the relative decline of the UK, and the rise first of the US and Germany, and then later of Japan and China. We then econometrically estimate trajectories on (i) the post-1902 period for France, Germany, Japan, the UK and US, and (ii) the post-1960 period for a wider sample of 40 countries. Our trajectories are strongly positively correlated with Total Factor Productivity growth, and also (but less strongly) associated with the growth of labour productivity and capital intensity. We show that future trajectories are predicted by a country's initial levels of R&D, education and defence spending, classic drivers of innovation in modern growth theory.
abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种衡量各国创新能力跨国趋势的方法——“技术轨迹”，并将其应用于一个涵盖1836年至2016年间多国专利的新丰富数据集。直观上，技术轨迹通过一国在多个专利局持续增加的专利申请量得以显现。我们首先描述了数据模式，展示了英国的相对衰退，以及美国、德国先崛起，随后日本和中国相继崛起的趋势。接着，我们运用计量经济学方法估计了（i）1902年后法国、德国、日本、英国和美国的技术轨迹，以及（ii）1960年后更广泛样本中40个国家的技术轨迹。我们的技术轨迹与全要素生产率增长呈强正相关，同时（虽然较弱）也与劳动生产率增长和资本密集度相关联。我们还发现，未来的技术轨迹可由一国初始的研发投入、教育水平和国防支出预测，这些正是现代增长理论中创新的经典驱动因素。

title: The reset premium: Option value under asymmetric price commitment
title_zh: 重置溢价：非对称价格承诺下的期权价值
title_primary: 重置溢价：非对称价格承诺下的期权价值
title_secondary: The reset premium: Option value under asymmetric price commitment
abstract: We show that a one-sided price-adjustment rule, with free price cuts but a fixed daily reset for price increases, raises the reset price even under risk neutrality, mean-zero wholesale cost shocks, and perfect consumer information. The mechanism is option-theoretic: a higher reset price preserves pass-through in adverse cost states, while favorable shocks can still be accommodated by price cuts. In differentiated Bertrand competition, the reset premium scales with cost pass-through and hence with substitutability. The mechanism is distinct from consumer search and strategic price dispersion because it operates even under perfect consumer price information.
abstract_zh: 我们证明，在风险中性、零均值批发成本冲击及消费者完全信息的条件下，单边价格调整规则——即允许自由降价但设定每日固定重置以应对涨价——仍会提高重置价格。其机制具有期权理论特征：较高的重置价格在不利成本状态下保持传导效应，而有利冲击则可通过降价来适应。在差异化伯特兰竞争中，重置溢价随成本传导程度及替代性增强而扩大。该机制不同于消费者搜索和策略性价格离散，因为它即使在消费者完全知晓价格信息的情况下也发挥作用。

title: The price of delay: How supply chain disruptions spread into consumer prices
title_zh: 延迟的代价：供应链中断如何传导至消费者价格
title_primary: 延迟的代价：供应链中断如何传导至消费者价格
title_secondary: The price of delay: How supply chain disruptions spread into consumer prices
abstract: Supply chain disruptions have become a recurring feature of recent economic dynamics and an increasing concern in inflation policy discussions. This column argues that inflationary effects of these disruptions operate through more than higher import and transportation costs: when supply-chain bottlenecks make products harder to replenish, firms’ pricing power increases, and these price increases are further amplified by strategic responses to competitors’ disruptions. Using new data that link consumer prices to US maritime import shipments by consumer goods producers, the authors show that these competitive pricing spillovers substantially amplified the price effects of supply chain disruptions in the aftermath of the pandemic in the US.
abstract_zh: 供应链中断已成为近期经济动态中反复出现的特征，并在通胀政策讨论中日益受到关注。本专栏认为，这些中断的通胀效应不仅通过提高进口和运输成本发挥作用：当供应链瓶颈导致产品补货困难时，企业的定价能力增强，而这些价格上涨还会因企业对竞争对手中断的战略反应而进一步放大。通过使用将消费者价格与美国消费品生产商的海运进口货物联系起来的新数据，作者表明，这些竞争性定价溢出效应显著放大了疫情后美国供应链中断的价格影响。

title: Health Care Reform and Firm Dynamics: Evidence from Medicare Part D and the Retail Pharmacy Industry
title_zh: 医疗改革与企业动态：来自Medicare D部分与零售药房行业的证据
title_primary: 医疗改革与企业动态：来自Medicare D部分与零售药房行业的证据
title_secondary: Health Care Reform and Firm Dynamics: Evidence from Medicare Part D and the Retail Pharmacy Industry
authors: Brandyn F. Churchill, Georgina Cisneros, Kelli R. Marquardt
official: 官方在线 2026-06-29 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Health care reforms are often enacted before implementation, creating uncertainty that can shape firms’ decisions. We examine how Medicare Part D affected the retail pharmacy industry using 2000-2009 establishment-level data, leveraging the fact that Part D disproportionately affected counties with larger elderly populations. Consistent with predictions from a conceptual model in which pre-implementation uncertainty discourages entry and lower post-implementation margins prevent full recovery, we find that Part D was associated with a 5-percent reduction in pharmacies, driven by fewer openings rather than more closures. We also find suggestive evidence that reduced pharmacy access dampened Part D’s mortality benefits.
abstract_zh: 医疗改革往往在实施前就已颁布，由此产生的不确定性会影响企业的决策。我们利用2000-2009年的机构层面数据，并借助D部分（Part D）对老年人口比例较高县的影响更为显著这一事实，考察了医疗保险D部分如何影响零售药店行业。与概念模型的预测一致——该模型认为实施前的不确定性抑制了市场进入，而实施后较低的利润率又阻碍了完全恢复——我们发现D部分与药店数量减少5%相关，这主要是由于新店开业减少而非关店增加所致。我们还发现初步证据表明，药店可及性的降低削弱了D部分在降低死亡率方面的益处。

title: Examining the Gender Pay Gap Among Youth: Insights from Egypt, Jordan, and Palestine
title_zh: 青年性别工资差距研究：来自埃及、约旦和巴勒斯坦的启示
title_primary: 青年性别工资差距研究：来自埃及、约旦和巴勒斯坦的启示
title_secondary: Examining the Gender Pay Gap Among Youth: Insights from Egypt, Jordan, and Palestine
official: 官方在线 2026-06-15 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper examines the gender pay gap among youth aged 15-29 in Egypt, Jordan, and Palestine using the 2021 Labor Force Surveys. The analysis identifies the main determinants of wages for young men and women and estimates the extent of gender-based wage disparities. The Oaxaca-Blinder decomposition is used to distinguish the share of the wage gap explained by observable characteristics from the unexplained component, often associated with discrimination. Melly's quantile decomposition is applied from the 10th to the 90th percentile. The findings show that youth wages are positively associated with higher education and professional experience. A significant gender pay gap favoring young men is found in Egypt and Palestine, with Egypt showing the largest disparity. In Jordan, the average gap is small and statistically insignificant, with young women slightly out-earning young men. However, the decomposition results reveal a significant positive unexplained component across all three countries, suggesting persistent disparities after accounting for observable factors. The quantile analysis further shows a "sticky floorâ€ effect in Egypt and a "glass ceilingâ€ effect in Palestine.
abstract_zh: 本文利用2021年劳动力调查数据，考察埃及、约旦和巴勒斯坦15-29岁青年的性别工资差距。分析确定了青年男性和女性工资的主要决定因素，并估算了基于性别的工资差异程度。采用奥克萨卡-布林德分解法，将可观测特征解释的工资差距部分与通常归因于歧视的未解释部分区分开来。同时，应用梅利分位数分解法，从第10百分位到第90百分位进行分析。研究结果表明，青年工资与高等教育和职业经验呈正相关。在埃及和巴勒斯坦，存在显著有利于青年男性的性别工资差距，其中埃及的差距最大。在约旦，平均差距较小且统计上不显著，青年女性收入略高于青年男性。然而，分解结果显示，三个国家均存在显著的正向未解释成分，表明在控制可观测因素后，差距依然持续存在。分位数分析进一步揭示了埃及的“粘地板”效应和巴勒斯坦的“玻璃天花板”效应。

title: Disincentive effects of unemployment insurance benefits
title_zh: 失业保险金的抑制效应
title_primary: 失业保险金的抑制效应
title_secondary: Disincentive effects of unemployment insurance benefits
authors: Andreas Hornstein, Marios Karabarbounis, André Kurmann, Etienne Lalé, Lien Ta
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-11 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Unemployment insurance (UI) acts both as a disincentive for labor supply and as a demand stimulus which may explain why empirical studies often find limited effects of UI on employment. This paper provides independent estimates of the disincentive effects arising from the largest expansion of UI in U.S. history, the pandemic unemployment benefits. Using high-frequency data on small restaurants and retailers from Homebase, we control for local demand effects by comparing neighboring businesses that largely share the positive impact of UI stimulus. We find that employment in low-wage businesses recovered more slowly than employment in high-wage businesses in labor markets with larger differences in the relative generosity of pandemic UI benefits. According to a labor search model that replicates the estimated employment differences between low-and high-wage businesses, the disincentive effects from the pandemic UI programs held back the aggregate employment recovery by 4.7 percentage points between April and December 2020.

title: Macroeconomic policymaking in interwar Britain: A reappraisal
title_zh: 两次世界大战期间英国的宏观经济政策制定：再评价
title_primary: 两次世界大战期间英国的宏观经济政策制定：再评价
title_secondary: Macroeconomic policymaking in interwar Britain: A reappraisal
abstract: This paper brings together modern empirical techniques with contemporary high frequency data to fill two prominent gaps in the literature on Britain's interwar years: what were the quantitative effects of monetary policy on unemployment and prices in the years 1919–38, and how did that compare with the effects of fiscal policy? Its specific innovation is to draw on a previously little‐used weekly publication of public finance statistics, allowing the roles of monetary policy, taxation, and public spending to be assessed side‐by‐side in a coherent framework – a structural vector autoregression identified with sign restrictions. In a period of particularly unsettled policy, I find that policy shocks, both monetary and fiscal, made a material contribution to variation in prices and unemployment and played a central role in the two great recessions of the period, modern Britain's most severe. Other macroeconomic policy choices could have delivered better outcomes for prices and unemployment, but this would have required making different choices in the face of conflicting objectives and some sharp trade‐offs.

title: Covered interest parity in emerging markets: Measurement and drivers
title_zh: 新兴市场中的抛补利率平价：测度与驱动因素
title_primary: 新兴市场中的抛补利率平价：测度与驱动因素
title_secondary: Covered interest parity in emerging markets: Measurement and drivers
abstract: We study the behavior of Covered Interest Parity (CIP) deviations – aka the CIP basis – in Emerging Markets (EM). A major challenge in computing the CIP basis in EM’s lies in measuring local currency interest rates which are free of local credit risk and market segmentation. To do so, we construct a ‘purified’ CIP basis for eight major EM currencies using supranational bonds issued in EM local currencies and US dollar going back twenty years. We show that this ‘purified’ CIP basis aligns well with theory-implied predictions. In the cross-section and the time-series, the basis correlates with fundamental forces driving supply and demand for dollar forwards. Shocks to global dollar funding costs, global intermediary’s balance sheet capacity, and the demand for dollar safe assets interact with currency-specific dollar hedging and funding needs in moving the CIP basis in EM’s.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了新兴市场中覆盖利率平价（CIP）偏离——即CIP基差——的行为。在新兴市场计算CIP基差的一个主要挑战在于衡量不受当地信用风险和市场分割影响的本币利率。为此，我们利用以新兴市场本币和美元发行的超国家债券，构建了八种主要新兴市场货币的“净化”CIP基差，时间跨度达二十年。我们表明，这一“净化”CIP基差与理论预测高度吻合。在横截面和时间序列上，该基差与驱动美元远期供需的基本力量相关联。全球美元融资成本冲击、全球中介机构资产负债表容量以及美元安全资产需求的变化，与货币特定的美元对冲和融资需求相互作用，共同影响新兴市场CIP基差的变动。

title: Granularity in the current account
abstract: We present new empirical evidence on the role of granularity in the current account (CA), using a unique and comprehensive firm-level dataset for Switzerland. We show that idiosyncratic shocks to large firms account for almost two thirds of the fluctuations in the headline CA and are the primary source of CA volatility. The granular effect is present across goods, services, and income components and persists over both short- and medium-term horizons. In addition to their direct impact, idiosyncratic shocks propagate through inter-firm linkages via input–output relationships and cross-product connections associated with multinational enterprise activity. Our findings complement standard macroeconomic models by providing a micro-founded perspective and demonstrating the importance of granularity in explaining fluctuations in external balances.
abstract_zh: 我们利用瑞士独特且全面的企业层面数据集，提供了关于颗粒度在经常账户（CA）中作用的新实证证据。我们表明，大型企业的特质性冲击几乎解释了头条CA波动的三分之二，并且是CA波动性的主要来源。这种颗粒效应存在于商品、服务和收入组成部分中，并在短期和中期时间跨度内持续存在。除了直接影响外，特质性冲击还通过企业间联系，经由投入产出关系及与跨国企业活动相关的跨产品连接进行传播。我们的发现通过提供微观基础视角并展示颗粒度在解释外部平衡波动中的重要性，补充了标准宏观经济模型。

title: The adoption of artificial intelligence and enterprises’ breakthrough innovation: an analysis based on China’s patent citation network
title_zh: 人工智能应用与企业突破性创新：基于中国专利引用网络的分析
title_primary: 人工智能应用与企业突破性创新：基于中国专利引用网络的分析
title_secondary: The adoption of artificial intelligence and enterprises’ breakthrough innovation: an analysis based on China’s patent citation network
abstract: This study examines the impact of artificial intelligence (AI) adoption on breakthrough innovation in Chinese listed enterprises between 2007 and 2023. The results show that the AI adoption significantly improves an enterprises’ ability to achieve breakthrough innovation. Moreover, mechanism analysis demonstrates that AI adoption promotes breakthrough innovation by increasing knowledge diversity, overcoming organizational inertia and improving resource allocation efficiency. Furthermore, absorptive capacity is crucial in bolstering AI adoption’s impact on breakthrough innovation. A heterogeneity analysis reveals that state-owned enterprises, enterprises in highly competitive industries and more market-oriented regions see a stronger empowering effect in leveraging AI for breakthrough innovation. Additionally, compared with incremental innovation, AI adoption exerts a stronger positive effect on breakthrough innovation. The findings deepen our understanding of the pathways through which AI fosters breakthrough innovation and has practical implications for enterprises seeking to leverage AI to make technological progress.
abstract_zh: 本研究考察了2007年至2023年间中国上市公司采用人工智能（AI）对突破性创新的影响。结果表明，AI采用显著提升了企业实现突破性创新的能力。进一步机制分析显示，AI采用通过增加知识多样性、克服组织惯性以及提高资源配置效率来促进突破性创新。此外，吸收能力在强化AI采用对突破性创新的影响中起到关键作用。异质性分析表明，国有企业、处于高竞争行业及市场化程度较高地区的企业，在利用AI实现突破性创新时展现出更强的赋能效应。同时，相较于渐进式创新，AI采用对突破性创新的正向影响更为显著。这些发现深化了我们对AI促进突破性创新路径的理解，并为寻求借助AI实现技术进步的企业提供了实践启示。
